problem_type: Typed public domain errors lose their code at a transport boundary
symptom: PR #661 production-mcp journey fails: document_not_found becomes errorCode null while isError remains true.
direct_cause: rpcErrorWirePayload preserves fields only for RpcError instances; documentSurface throws an Error with code, so GUI RPC serializes only its message.
class_root: Public error projection is applied after a lossy transport serialization; direct dispatch and GUI RPC do not preserve the same public outcome.
affected_population: GUI-connected MCP stdio and packaged MCP clients receiving typed domain failures
Document and canvas errors constructed outside RpcError
internal_only_reason: This is the existing internal authenticated RPC envelope and existing public MCP error projection; no external protocol or dependency behavior changes.
invariants: Every recognized public domain error retains its code across the shared RPC wire boundary.
Unknown native codes and arbitrary exception fields are not added to the wire.
generality_proof: The shared serializer uses the existing MCP public error projection for non-RpcError exceptions, so all registered public domain errors receive the same outcome on direct and GUI-connected routes without per-tool fixes.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Preserve public error identity before transport discards exception properties.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: RPC response catch calls rpcErrorWirePayload; stdio and packaged launcher use rpcErrorFromPayload.
All three host error emission paths call rpcErrorWirePayload.
Both missing project and missing creation document use Error plus code.
Direct dispatch retains exception properties in process; used as parity reference.

recurrence.reason: Any typed domain Error routed through the GUI RPC path loses its code on every run; direct route unit coverage hides this.
same_class_scan: rg rpcErrorWirePayload electron/capabilityCore: rpcServer and host serializers inspected
rg document_not_found electron: documentSurface producer and semantic matrix consumer inspected
mcpRpcErrorFromPayload callers: mcpStdioServer and mcpNodeLauncher inspected

prevention.invariant: Recognized public error identity survives serialization for every caller.
prevention.failure_mode: Only existing public projection fields are emitted; unrecognized errors remain strings and never gain arbitrary exception properties.
prevention.strategy: Reuse buildToolErrorOutcome at the existing serializer, retaining the current RpcError recovery contract.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the unconditional string downgrade for non-RpcError public domain errors within the single serializer.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The defect is internal exception serialization, independent of Electron or MCP SDK versions.

migration: No stored data changes. Existing string and structured RPC consumers remain supported.
residual_risks: Linux CI verification pending; macOS full loopback now passes 7/7 including 58 production-mcp assertions.

invariant_owner_layer.reason: The shared RPC serializer is the first point that discards typed exception fields.
